pako: (MIT AND Zlib) — both MIT and Zlib are permissive, EUPL-1.2 / AGPL-3.0 compatible licenses. The compound SPDX AND expression confuses the allowlist matcher (it looks for exact-match licenses, not SPDX AND/OR expressions). Approved 2026-05-20.
sha.js: (MIT AND BSD-3-Clause) — both MIT and BSD-3-Clause are permissive, EUPL-1.2 / AGPL-3.0 compatible licenses. Same compound-SPDX matcher limitation as pako. Approved 2026-05-20.
